bio.text: Ryan Braunberger, a Democrat from Fargo, represents District 10 in the North Dakota Senate and serves as Senate Minority Caucus Leader.
He is the Democratic candidate for North Dakota Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Fargo and earned an associate degree in business administration from Southeastern Technical College (2007) and a bachelor's degree in social work from Minnesota State University Moorhead (2022).
His legislative biography lists his occupation as transportation specialist.
